description: This file defines the ChannelId struct and InternalChannelId struct within the Orleans.BroadcastChannel namespace. It provides mechanisms for creating, comparing, serializing, and formatting channel identifiers used in Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: ChannelId
classes.description: A struct representing a unique identifier for a broadcast channel, including methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and string formatting.

classes.name: InternalChannelId
classes.description: A struct encapsulating a ChannelId with additional provider name information, supporting comparison, serialization, and string formatting.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a ChannelId from namespace and key, either as spans, GUID, or strings.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this ChannelId with another for ordering.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for the ChannelId.

methods.name: GetKeyAsString
methods.description: Returns the key component as a UTF8 string.

methods.name: GetNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace component as a string, if available.
